adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/embeddable_host.rb`, `record_for_host` explicitly returns `false` on parse/blank-host failures (`return false unless uri.present?`, etc.), otherwise returns an AR record or `nil` from `where(...).first`. Callers in the diff do tolerate this (e.g. `TopicEmbed.import` uses `eh.try(:category_id)`, and in Rails `false.try(...)` yields `nil`; `host_allowed?` uses `.present?` which is also `false` for `false`). So it’s not a verifiable defect, but it is a real diff-grounded API/type-boundary wart: the method’s return type is inconsistent (`EmbeddableHost | nil | false`), making callers rely on Rails quirks and reducing uniformity vs. returning `nil` for “not found/invalid”.
